scope: Standalone QUANTIZE opcode and DMA transport. Full Attention opcode decomposition is pending separate arithmetic modules.
command_source: PS-preloaded command BRAM, existing native controller fetch path

END.effect: Drain tracked commands and owners, then DONE.

MM2S.effect: Transfer to local bank; status follows accepted writes.

S2MM.effect: Transfer from local bank; status follows received read responses and output acceptance.

QUANTIZE.operand2: BF16 scale output logical bank ID
QUANTIZE.raw_address_fields: zero and not passed to the compute executor
QUANTIZE.address_generation: Executor starts at word0 and traverses logical row internally.
QUANTIZE.granularity: one Activation token row, KV token/head row or Weight group of up to32
QUANTIZE.completion: All source read responses processed, all INT4 packed output writes and BF16 scale write accepted before matching completion; role-specific release accepted before tracking retirement.

example_program: MM2S(source DDR, FP32 bank0, padded source bytes)
QUANTIZE(src bank0, data bank1, scale bank2, elements33)
S2MM(data bank1, output DDR, 32 padded bytes)
S2MM(scale bank2, scale DDR, 16 padded bytes)
validation_boundary: BFM DMA peers plus real native XPM bank memory; vendor DataMover and physical board are separate.
